_comment.fallback: If true, route to fallback target when usage >= usage_threshold (openai-codex only). Required for both Mode A and Mode B
_comment.fallback_backend: Optional. Omit or 'pi' = stay in pi, swap provider/model (Mode A; 'pi' is the recommended explicit form to avoid mix-ups). Set to another backend (e.g. 'cc'/'openclaw') = redirect the whole backend (Mode B). Quota-aware backends (gemini/agy/kimi) are rejected to avoid transitive loops
_comment.fallback_provider: Target provider when Mode A fallback triggers; ignored if fallback=false or when fallback_backend points to a non-pi backend (Mode B)
_comment.fallback_model: Target model when Mode A fallback triggers; ignored if fallback=false or when fallback_backend points to a non-pi backend (Mode B)
